items.heading: Saka Saka
details: Key ingredients: cassava leaves, palm oil, peanut paste, smoked fish
Pound or finely chop cassava leaves.
Simmer the leaves for a long time until tender.
Stir in palm oil, peanut paste and flaked smoked fish.
Continue cooking until the sauce is thick and serve with rice or fufu.

items.heading: Poisson Braise
details: Key ingredients: whole fish, chili, onion, lemon
Score and season a whole fish with chili, onion and lemon.
Marinate briefly to let the flavors penetrate.
Grill over charcoal, turning once, until charred and cooked through.
Serve hot with a spicy onion relish.
